Hi Jill — thanks for sending these over. I looped in Marissa (Finance AP) and Karthik (Procurement ops) so we can get you set up.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the items we need from Pacific Components to create a vendor record? From our side we typically require:
- Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (fillable PDF)
- Completed W-9 (if US entity)
- Bank details (voided check or bank letter for ACH)
- Signed master services agreement only if contract value exceeds our approval threshold

Jill, if you prefer to sign via DocuSign we can send a prefilled onboarding record for your e-signature. If procurement needs anything else (tax forms, vendor risk questionnaire), please let us know this week so we can hit the PO timelines.

Thanks — I will coordinate the intake and confirm the vendor ID once created.

Laura Bennett
Senior Vendor Programs Manager
